LanguageData.WotF_Augment_AOE.description: Widens the preceding effect across the surrounding area so multiple nearby targets are affected once each. Paired with explosion or planar shield, it directly expands blast radius or shield width.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_AOE.label: area
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Accelerate.description: Quickens the flow of mana: projectiles fly faster, orbiting orbs spin more swiftly, and lingering fields pulse at shorter intervals.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Accelerate.label: accelerate
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Amplify.description: Channels extra mana to heighten the preceding effect, scaling up damage, healing, push or pull distance, and other potencies.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Amplify.label: amplify
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_BreakArmor.description: Sharpens the preceding damage effect to punch more readily through heavy armor.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_BreakArmor.label: break armor
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Dampen.description: Tempers the mana fed into the preceding effect, softening damage, dimming light, and shortening push or pull distance.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Dampen.label: dampen
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Decelerate.description: Slows the pace of mana flow, reducing projectile flight speed and orbiting orb rotation, or lengthening the interval between pulses of a lingering field.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Decelerate.label: decelerate
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Extend.description: Prolongs the spell's persistence, keeping the preceding effect or form active longer or stretching its wait time.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Extend.label: extend time
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Pierce.description: Allows a projectile to keep flying after impact and strike targets behind. Each target pierced consumes one charge; cannot be combined with split.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Pierce.label: pierce
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Sensitive.description: Reins in stray shockwaves so violent effects like explosion spare surrounding structures and strike only targets caught within.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Sensitive.label: sensitive
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Shorten.description: Hastens the spell's close, shortening the duration or wait time of the preceding effect or form.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Shorten.label: shorten time
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Split.description: Divides gathered mana so projectiles fire in greater numbers, or adds extra orbs to an orbit form. On projectiles, cannot be combined with pierce.
LanguageData.WotF_Augment_Split.label: split
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Blink.description: Briefly warps space to relocate the caster. Cast on self, the caster leaps forward in the direction they face; delivered via projectile or touch, the caster appears directly at the spell's landing point.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Blink.label: blink
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_ColdSnap.description: Detonates biting cold around the target to deal damage. If the target is already frozen, the burst deals multiplied damage.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_ColdSnap.label: cold snap
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Delay.description: Holds back the release of mana, delaying all subsequent effects by a few seconds before triggering them together at the original target point.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Delay.label: delay
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Explosion.description: Triggers a violent blast at the impact point, catching everything nearby. Pairing with area expands the blast radius, while sensitive deals damage without harming buildings.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Explosion.label: explosion
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Freeze.description: Wraps the target in biting frost that reduces movement capacity for a time without impairing other functions.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Freeze.label: freeze
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Grow.description: Infuses gentle vitality into the soil, accelerating plant growth at the impact cell for a while. Paired with area, an entire patch of surrounding ground benefits together.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Grow.label: grow
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Hack.description: An unusual channeled effect that forces its way into a hostile mechanoid's command circuit. As long as the caster channels uninterrupted, the stunned mechanoid temporarily defects and obeys the caster.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Hack.label: hack
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Harm.description: Slams condensed mana into the target for armor-piercing blunt damage that batters flesh and structures alike.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Harm.label: harm
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Heal.description: A gentle supportive rune that swiftly seals wounds without medicine and hastens their recovery.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Heal.label: clot
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Hex.description: Carves a cold mark of misfortune onto the target, causing them to take increased damage while slowing both wound healing and mana recovery for a time.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Hex.label: hex
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Knockback.description: Unleashes a violent outward thrust from the impact point, hurling the target back. Paired with area, it blasts multiple nearby targets away at once.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Knockback.label: knockback
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Lightning.description: Calls down a fierce bolt of lightning that burns the target while disrupting nearby electronic and psychic circuits. Repeated strikes leave lingering static charge that makes each subsequent bolt deadlier—especially effective against mechanoids.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Lightning.label: lightning
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Linger.description: Leaves a pulsing mana field at the landing point that repeatedly applies all subsequent effects to every pawn inside until it fades. Accelerate and decelerate adjust its pulse rate.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Linger.label: linger
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Magelight.description: Condenses a gentle orb of mana light at the impact point, illuminating its surroundings for a time. Both its glow radius and duration can be shaped by augment runes.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Magelight.label: magelight
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_PlanarShield.description: Raises a one-way mana barrier across the caster's line of sight at the target point, blocking hostile direct-fire projectiles and arcane missiles while letting allied shots pass from any direction. The barrier fades when its charges run out or its duration expires; amplify adds charges, and area widens the wall.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_PlanarShield.label: planar shield
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Pull.description: Conjures an unseen pull at the impact point, yanking the target straight toward the center across a distance scaled by spell potency.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Pull.label: pull
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Rune.description: Etches a hidden seal onto the ground without occupying building space. The first pawn to step onto it triggers all subsequent effects, consuming the seal.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Rune.label: rune
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Snare.description: Pins the target in place with unseen mana. Held targets cannot move for a time, though they can still attack normally.
LanguageData.WotF_Effect_Snare.label: snare
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Orbit.description: Summons orbiting mana orbs around the caster without requiring a target. Each orb triggers all subsequent effects on the first target it touches.
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Orbit.label: orbit
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Projectile.description: The most common spell form, projecting subsequent spell effects across a distance.
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Projectile.label: projectile
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Self.description: Focuses the spell directly upon the caster and the ground beneath their feet, requiring no aiming.
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Self.label: self
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Touch.description: Delivers the spell by close touch, affecting only an adjacent tile and blocked by walls.
LanguageData.WotF_Form_Touch.label: touch
